visibility.description: Who may see the activity (app.activitytracker.actor.defs#visibility), from where its record is stored. Absent means public.

likeCount.description: Likes from athletes who, like the viewer, may see the activity at its current visibility.

commentCount.description: Comments the viewer may see: from athletes who may see the activity at its current visibility, written for an audience that admits the viewer, and not hidden by the activity's athlete (app.activitytracker.feed.commentHide).

recordings.description: Other recordings of this activity (feed.activity#recordingOf), oldest first; absent when it has none.

members.description: A combined activity's members (feed.activity#combined) the AppView admits, oldest first; absent on an activity that combines nothing. likeCount and commentCount include the likes and comments on them.

combinedInto.description: On a member, the combined activity it is part of; absent otherwise.

media.description: The record's media, with URLs to load them from; absent when it has none.

details.description: The activity's app.activitytracker.feed.activityDetails records from the tiers the viewer is admitted to, widest first; absent when there are none. Their fields go on top of record's, a narrower tier's last.

gear.description: The gear the activity lists that the viewer may see: in a tier of its gear category they're admitted to, and an item they may see that still exists, in the athlete's order. record and details carry only these items' URIs. Absent when there is none.

group.description: Other athletes' activities this one was done together with (feed/group-activities) that the viewer may see: each partner's activity at the narrowest of its visibility and its Start time and Map categories, no block either way, and no mute by the viewer. Most recently paired first. Absent when there are none.

diveSite.description: The dive site this dive visited (dive-sites/site-visits), when the viewer may see the visit: at the narrowest of the activity's visibility and its Map category's. Absent otherwise; show the record's own dive.site text then.

labels.description: Labels on the activity, which apply to each of its photos too; the author's account labels are on author. Absent when there are none.

visibility.description: The tier the record is stored in.

recordingView.description: Another device's recording of an activity, which feeds don't show on its own.

groupPartner.description: Another athlete's activity done together with this one.

inviteView.description: An app.activitytracker.feed.activityInvite naming the viewer (feed/activity-invites), with what it lets them copy.

activity.description: The activity the viewer was added to.

record.description: The activity's core fields and its startTime, map and speed fields, merged from every tier whatever the viewer may otherwise see. No other category's fields, no photos, description or gear.

inviteeView.description: One follower an athlete added to their own activity, as the athlete sees it.

status.description: joined once the invitee's copy is paired with the activity; pending otherwise, including when they declined, which the AppView never learns.

memberView.description: One recording a combined activity is built from, which feeds don't show on its own.

like.description: URI of the viewer's like record, if any. A like on a non-public activity is stored in the giver's interactions space, under the same repo-style URI.

hidden.description: The activity's athlete hid this comment (app.activitytracker.feed.commentHide). Present only for the athlete and the commenter, the only viewers a hidden comment is listed for.

audience.description: Who the comment was written for (app.activitytracker.feed.comment#audience), which caps the audience of a reply to it. Absent means public.

root.description: On a reply, the top-level comment of its thread (app.activitytracker.feed.comment#replyRef).

parent.description: On a reply, the comment it answers (app.activitytracker.feed.comment#replyRef).

labels.description: Labels on the comment; the commenter's account labels are on author. Absent when there are none.

threadView.description: A top-level comment and its first replies listed for the viewer, oldest first.

root.description: The top-level comment. Absent when it isn't listed for the viewer (deleted, hidden, or its commenter can no longer see the activity) but some of its replies are: the client shows a placeholder, and nothing here says why.

replies.description: The thread's oldest replies listed for the viewer, at most three.

replyCount.description: The thread's replies listed for the viewer.

repliesCursor.description: When replyCount is more than replies holds, the cursor for app.activitytracker.feed.getComments with root to list the rest.

elevationProfile.description: A segment's smoothed terrain heights, derived by the AppView (segments/segment-elevation): evenly spaced along its line, the first at its start and the last at its end, so each is distanceMeters / (length - 1) apart.

heights.description: Heights above sea level in decimeters.

maxGrade.description: The steepest absolute grade along the line in tenths of a percent, each measured over about 50 m of the smoothed terrain the heights come from, at full sample resolution. Descents count like climbs. Absent on profiles derived before it was.

distanceMeters.description: The line's length, computed by the AppView.

status.description: Derived by the AppView, never read from the record. Absent or unknown means active.

duplicateOf.description: The earlier segment this one duplicates, when status is duplicate.

elevationGain.description: Meters climbed from start to end, derived by the AppView (segments/segment-elevation), never read from the record: from smoothed terrain along the line wherever terrain covers it, else from enough distinct athletes' efforts. Absent when it has none.

elevationLoss.description: Meters descended from start to end, derived like elevationGain. Absent when it has none.

elevationSource.description: Where elevationGain and elevationLoss came from: terrain data along the line, which wins wherever it covers the whole line, or the median of enough distinct athletes' efforts, only for segments terrain doesn't cover. Absent when they are.

name.description: The segment's current name: its latest adopted community name still in effect, or record.name (its original name) when it has none. Absent from older AppViews; use record.name then.

nameHistory.description: Adopted names still in effect, newest first. Served by app.activitytracker.feed.getSegment only.

nameProposals.description: Open name proposals the viewer may see. Served by app.activitytracker.feed.getSegment only.

segmentNameAdoption.description: A community name a segment adopted.

up.description: Up votes counted when it was adopted.

down.description: Down votes counted when it was adopted.

proposer.description: Absent when the viewer and the proposer block each other, or the proposal record was deleted.

segmentNameProposalView.description: An open name proposal with its vote totals. Never says who voted, except the viewer's own vote.

cid.description: The version votes count for; a vote names it in its subject.

openedAt.description: When it was accepted, or last edited.

segmentNameViewerVote.description: The viewer's own counted vote on a proposal.

uri.description: The vote record, in the viewer's interactions space.

best.description: The viewer's own fastest effort on the segment; absent when they have none.

canProposeName.description: The viewer may propose a name now (segments/segment-names). Served by getSegment only; absent means false.

canVoteOnNames.description: The viewer may vote on name proposals: they have an effort on the segment. Served by getSegment only; absent means false.

name.description: The segment's current name, as segmentView's name.

distanceMeters.description: The line's length, computed by the AppView.

status.description: As segmentView's status. Absent or unknown means active.

effortView.description: One pass of an activity over a segment from its start to its end (app.activitytracker.feed.getActivitySegments, getSegmentEfforts and getSegmentLeaderboard entries). Served only to viewers admitted to the narrowest of the activity's visibility and its map and pace/speed categories.

startOffset.description: Seconds from the activity's start to the effort's.

elapsed.description: Seconds from the segment's start to its end.

startedOn.description: The activity's local date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

eBike.description: The activity is an e-bike ride. Absent means false.

best.description: The athlete's fastest effort on the segment among those the viewer may see. Never set on a lift. Absent means false.

rank.description: Set by app.activitytracker.feed.getActivitySegments only on a best effort ranked in the top 10 of the segment's all-time, everyone leaderboard (for its e-bike kind) as this viewer sees it.

notRanked.description: Why leaderboards don't rank this effort, served only to its own athlete and only on an active segment that isn't a lift: they hide from leaderboards, the activity is excluded, or it is faster than its sport group's cap. Never served to anyone else.

leaderboardEntry.description: One athlete's place on a segment leaderboard (app.activitytracker.feed.getSegmentLeaderboard): their fastest ranked effort that the viewer may see.

rank.description: 1 for the fastest; athletes with equal times share a rank, and the next rank skips.

mayorEntry.description: One athlete's place on a segment's Mayors board (app.activitytracker.feed.getSegmentMayors): how many of their efforts the board counts.

rank.description: 1 for the most efforts, the segment's Mayor; equal counts reached on the same date share a rank, and the next rank skips.

efforts.description: How many of the athlete's efforts the board counts.

reachedOn.description: The local date of their latest counted effort, which reached the count, as YYYY-MM-DD.

status.description: Derived by the AppView, never read from the record. Absent or unknown means active.

duplicateOf.description: The earlier site this one duplicates, when status is duplicate.

name.description: The site's current name: its latest adopted community name still in effect (dive-sites/site-names), or record.name (its original name) when it has none.

nameHistory.description: Adopted names still in effect, newest first. Served by app.activitytracker.feed.getDiveSite only.

nameProposals.description: Open name proposals the viewer may see. Served by app.activitytracker.feed.getDiveSite only.

canProposeName.description: The viewer may propose a name now (dive-sites/site-names). Served by getDiveSite only; absent means false.

canVoteOnNames.description: The viewer may vote on name proposals: they have a visit to the site. Served by getDiveSite only; absent means false.

name.description: The site's current name, as diveSiteView's name.

status.description: As diveSiteView's status. Absent or unknown means active.

diveSiteConditions.description: A dive site's conditions over the dives used (app.activitytracker.feed.getDiveSiteConditions). Each value comes only from the dives that record it, and is absent when none does.

dives.description: How many dives the conditions come from.

minTemperature.description: The lowest of the dives' coldest water temperatures, in tenths of a degree Celsius.

medianTemperature.description: The median of the dives' coldest water temperatures, in tenths of a degree Celsius.

maxTemperature.description: The highest of the dives' coldest water temperatures, in tenths of a degree Celsius.

medianMaxDepth.description: The median of the dives' maximum depths, in centimeters.

maxDepth.description: The greatest of the dives' maximum depths, in centimeters.

months.description: One per calendar month with dives, by the dive's local date, January first.

diveSiteRegularEntry.description: One athlete's place on a dive site's Regulars board (app.activitytracker.feed.getDiveSiteRegulars): how many of their visits the board counts.

rank.description: 1 for the most visits; equal counts reached on the same date share a rank, and the next rank skips.

visits.description: How many of the athlete's visits the board counts.

reachedOn.description: The local date of their latest counted visit, which reached the count, as YYYY-MM-DD.

postView.description: A post (app.activitytracker.feed.post) the viewer may see: at its tier, with no block either way, and while its embed may be shown.

visibility.description: Who may see the post (app.activitytracker.actor.defs#visibility), from where its record is stored. Absent means public.

embed.description: What the post shares, as the viewer may see it now. An open union: later AppViews may add other kinds, which older clients show as unavailable.

createdAt.description: As the record gives it, capped at indexedAt; places the post on the timeline.

likeCount.description: Likes the viewer is shown: from givers who, like the viewer, may see the post at its current tier, with no block between giver and viewer. An author's like of their own post isn't counted.

commentCount.description: Comments and replies the viewer is shown that the post's author hasn't hidden (app.activitytracker.feed.commentHide): what app.activitytracker.feed.getComments lists for them, less those marked hidden.

labels.description: Labels on the post; the author's account labels are on author. Absent when there are none.

postViewerState.description: The signed-in viewer's relation to a post.

like.description: URI of the viewer's like on the post, if any. A like on a non-public post is stored in the giver's interactions space, under the same repo-style URI.

postProposalEmbedView.description: A shared name proposal as it stands now (segments/segment-names): its latest name, status and totals. Never says who voted, except the viewer's own vote.

segment.description: The segment it names, with its current name; absent when it names a dive site.

diveSite.description: The dive site it names, with its current name; absent when it names a segment.

proposal.description: The proposal's latest version, which votes name.

openedAt.description: When it was accepted, or last edited.

up.description: Counted up votes; final once closed.

down.description: Counted down votes; final once closed.

canVote.description: The viewer may vote now: the proposal is open and they have an effort on the segment (a visit to the site). Absent means false.

importCardView.description: One timeline item standing for an athlete's batch import (feed.activity#importBatch): the batch's activities posted more than 5 days after they ended, when the viewer may see at least 5. Everything on it comes from those activities as the viewer may see them. Open it with app.activitytracker.feed.getImportBatch.

count.description: How many of the batch's activities the card stands for.

sports.description: How many of each sport, most first.

distance.description: Meters: the total of the distances the activities' own records give. Absent when none gives one.

routes.description: The routes of up to 4 of the activities, latest started first, from their own records.

postedAt.description: The latest post time among the activities, which places the card on the timeline.
